verdict.rationale: CAM has a documented Intellectual Property group page describing a team of "lawyers and engineers" handling a "wide spectrum of IP-related matters" including "patented and unpatented technology." The engineers suggest technical patent capability, but the evidence never explicitly describes patent drafting, filing, prosecution or portfolio strategy, and names no practitioners. Missing for 10: explicit patent prosecution/drafting/filing services, portfolio-strategy offering, named patent practitioners, independent corroboration (e.g., rankings or matters).
